text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: within each classifier. Bar length is log-odds z; the figure beside each bar is that z. Counts beside each country are the

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: passages available in that panel. Australia's procedural language is First Nations and the states; Türkiye's is participation

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: and institutions — a contrast the pooled comparison hid behind the much larger distributive class.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Log-odds ratio with informative Dirichlet prior, z-scored, on justice-labelled body-text passages from published non-litigation documents tagged to exactly one of the two countries, deduplicated on passage text.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Multilateral Climate Fund projects are excluded: Türkiye has 1,113 such passages and Australia none. Country names are removed from the vocabulary. One- and two-word terms are ranked separately.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Procedural justice has the thinnest evidence of the three panels. Turkish documents here are largely machine-translated, so some separation is translation register rather than policy substance.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Per-term rates per 10,000 words are in results/country_log_odds.csv.
